title: Toast and log count customers moved to COD
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, working in {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The shop's own term {Term-A}, due 20 days after the invoice date, is held by exactly two customers, {Customer-A} and {Customer-B}.
    For example: {Term-A} is ZZAUTOTEST DATA-26 N20, they are ZZAUTOTEST DATA-26 Alpha and ZZAUTOTEST DATA-26 Bravo.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group) is open on the Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" at the right of the {Term-A} row.
  2. Click "Move Customers".
  3. Choose "COD" in "Move To".
  4. Click "Move 2 Customers".
  5. Click "Set Limits To $0 And Move".
  6. Open the "⋯" page menu.
  7. Click "Audit Log".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the menu opens.
  • Step 2: "2 selected".
  • Step 3: the $0 line shows.
  • Step 4: the confirmation title reads "Set 2 customers' credit limit to $0?".
  • Step 5: the toast reads "2 customers moved to COD."
  • Step 6: the menu opens.
  • Step 7: the newest row reads "2 customers from {Term-A} to COD" followed by "Credit limit set to $0 (previous limits are in each customer's note)".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11673 (Story 4, Move Customers), story SV-11681 (Story 12, Credit Terms audit log)

  • S4-R9: “On confirm, each ticked customer's credit term changes to the chosen term, the window closes, the page's Customers counts update, and a success toast shows "{n} customers moved to {term}." ("1 customer moved to {term}." for one).”
  • S4-R14: “When "Move To" is COD or Credit Hold, pressing "Move {n} Customers" first opens a confirmation titled "Set {n} customers' credit limit to $0?" ("Set 1 customer's credit limit to $0?" for one), with the message "This can't be undone. Their current limits are kept in each customer's note, and the Credit Terms Log records the move." and the buttons "Cancel" and a red "Set Limits to $0 and Move" (displayed as "Set Limits To $0 And Move").”
  • S12-R3 table, customers moved: “Customers are moved (Story 4: Move Customers) | "Customers moved" | "{n} customers from {from} to {to}" ("1 customer from {from} to {to}" for one), followed by "Credit limit set to $0 (previous limits are in each customer's note)" when the target is COD or Credit Hold”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Customers moved | "{n} customers moved to {term}." / "1 customer moved to {term}." | Success toast”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Credit Terms Log events | "Credit term created", "Credit term edited", "Credit term deactivated", "Credit term reactivated", "Credit term deleted", "Default changed", "Customers moved" | Event column text, one row per saved change”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Credit Terms Log details | "{name}: {rule}" (created, deactivated, reactivated, deleted); "Name: {old} → {new}" and/or "Due: {old rule} → {new rule}" (edited); "{old} → {new}" (default changed); "{n} customers from {from} to {to}", plus "Credit limit set to $0 (previous limits are in each customer's note)" when the target is COD or Credit Hold (customers moved) | Details column text”
